# Subject: Symbol versioning and kABI

A GNU symbol-version node, an inline namespace used for ABI versioning, or a Linux kernel module's kABI CRC/namespace changes -- the mechanisms libraries use to version their own ABI, and what breaks when those mechanisms themselves move.
